```{r setup, include=FALSE}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(sf)
  library(sfnetworks)

  library(leaflet)
  library(plotly)

})
source(here::here("scripts", "00_utils.R"))

# CARTO basemaps require an API key (free for non-commercial use: https://carto.com/basemaps/apikey).
# Set CARTO_API_KEY in .Renviron. Note the key ends up in the rendered HTML, as with any browser tile key.
carto_api_key <- Sys.getenv("CARTO_API_KEY")
if (!nzchar(carto_api_key)) {
  stop("CARTO_API_KEY is not set. Request a key at https://carto.com/basemaps/apikey and add it to .Renviron.")
}

add_carto_tiles <- function(map, variant = "voyager_nolabels") {
  addTiles(
    map,
    urlTemplate = glue("https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/{variant}/{{z}}/{{x}}/{{y}}{{r}}.png?key={carto_api_key}"),
    attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
    options = tileOptions(maxZoom = 20)
  )
}
```

```{r load-outputs}
collapse_stop_points <- function(sf_data, group_cols) {
  sf_data %>%
    mutate(.geom = geometry) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(
      sf_data %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
        select(row_id, geometry),
      by = "row_id"
    ) %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    summarise(n_gtfs_stops = n(), do_union = TRUE, .groups = "drop") %>%
    st_point_on_surface()
}

# Builds a map pin as an SVG data URI so pins use exact legend colors
# (leaflet's awesome markers only offer a fixed color list).
make_pin_uri <- function(fill, icon_name) {
  glyph <- as.character(fontawesome::fa(icon_name))
  view_box <- sub('.*viewBox="([^"]+)".*', "\\1", glyph)
  glyph_path <- sub('.*<path d="([^"]+)".*', "\\1", glyph)
  svg <- glue(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="38" viewBox="-1 -1 28 38">',
    '<path d="M13 0C5.8 0 0 5.8 0 13c0 9.4 13 23 13 23s13-13.6 13-23C26 5.8 20.2 0 13 0z" fill="{fill}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/>',
    '<svg x="6.5" y="6.5" width="13" height="13" viewBox="{view_box}"><path d="{glyph_path}" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>',
    '</svg>'
  )
  paste0("data:image/svg+xml;base64,", base64enc::base64encode(charToRaw(svg)))
}

extract_walk_path <- function(network, from_sf, to_sf, label_text = "Walk path") {
  node_sf <- st_as_sf(network, "nodes")
  edge_sf <- st_as_sf(network, "edges")
  from_proj <- st_transform(from_sf[1, ], st_crs(node_sf))
  to_proj <- st_transform(to_sf[1, ], st_crs(node_sf))
  from_idx <- st_nearest_feature(from_proj, node_sf)
  to_idx <- st_nearest_feature(to_proj, node_sf)
  path_obj <- suppressWarnings(
    sfnetworks::st_network_paths(network, from = from_idx, to = to_idx, weights = "weight")
  )
  edge_idx <- path_obj$edge_paths[[1]]

  if (!length(edge_idx)) {
    return(
      st_sf(
        path_label = label_text,
        geometry = st_nearest_points(st_transform(from_proj, 4326), st_transform(to_proj, 4326))
      )
    )
  }

  edge_sf %>%
    slice(edge_idx) %>%
    st_transform(4326) %>%
    mutate(path_label = label_text)
}

# Routing Example: traces the median-departure bus + rail trip from one tract
# to Georgia Tech, using the same rules as 05 (scheduled board and alight,
# walks of up to 800 m at each end, transfer walks of up to 400 m).
example_geoid <- "13121010006"
example_dest_id <- "gatech"

example_stop_times <- readRDS(here::here("data_processed", "stop_times_full.rds"))
example_transfers <- readRDS(here::here("data_processed", "stop_transfers.rds"))
example_schedule <- as_tibble(example_stop_times) %>%
  transmute(trip_id, stop_id, stop_sequence, arr_s = as.numeric(arrival_time), dep_s = as.numeric(departure_time))
example_origin_stops <- origin_stop_lookup %>% filter(GEOID == example_geoid, scenario == "bus_rail")
example_dest_stops <- destination_stop_lookup %>% filter(dest_id == example_dest_id, scenario == "bus_rail")

example_start_times <- seq(as.numeric(hms::as_hms(departure_start)), as.numeric(hms::as_hms(departure_end)), by = 60)
example_journeys <- tidytransit::raptor(
  example_stop_times,
  example_transfers,
  stop_ids = example_origin_stops$stop_id,
  time_range = c(departure_start, format(hms::as_hms(max(example_start_times) + max_walk_meters / walk_speed_m_per_min * 60))),
  max_transfers = max_transfers,
  keep = "all"
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(to_stop_id %in% example_dest_stops$dest_stop_id, from_stop_id != to_stop_id) %>%
  semi_join(example_schedule, by = c("from_stop_id" = "stop_id", "journey_departure_time" = "dep_s")) %>%
  semi_join(example_schedule, by = c("to_stop_id" = "stop_id", "journey_arrival_time" = "arr_s")) %>%
  inner_join(example_origin_stops %>% select(from_stop_id = stop_id, walk_time_min), by = "from_stop_id") %>%
  inner_join(example_dest_stops %>% select(to_stop_id = dest_stop_id, dest_walk_time_min), by = "to_stop_id") %>%
  mutate(
    leave_by = journey_departure_time - walk_time_min * 60,
    arrive = journey_arrival_time + dest_walk_time_min * 60
  )

# Best journey for each home departure minute; the example uses the minute
# whose trip time is closest to the median.
example_by_start <- purrr::map_dfr(example_start_times, function(t) {
  example_journeys %>%
    filter(leave_by >= t) %>%
    slice_min(arrive, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(start_s = t, total_min = (arrive - t) / 60)
})
example_median_min <- median(example_by_start$total_min)
example_trip <- example_by_start %>%
  slice_min(abs(total_min - example_median_min), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

# Reconstructs the rides: the trip boarded at the first stop, then (if any)
# the transfer walk and second trip that reach the last stop on schedule.
trace_rides <- function(journey) {
  first_trips <- example_schedule %>%
    filter(stop_id == journey$from_stop_id, dep_s == journey$journey_departure_time)

  for (trip in first_trips$trip_id) {
    board_seq <- first_trips$stop_sequence[first_trips$trip_id == trip][1]
    downstream <- example_schedule %>%
      filter(trip_id == trip, stop_sequence > board_seq) %>%
      arrange(stop_sequence)

    direct <- downstream %>% filter(stop_id == journey$to_stop_id, arr_s == journey$journey_arrival_time)
    if (nrow(direct)) {
      return(tibble(trip_id = trip, board_stop = journey$from_stop_id, alight_stop = journey$to_stop_id,
                    dep_s = journey$journey_departure_time, arr_s = direct$arr_s[1]))
    }

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(downstream))) {
      alight <- downstream[i, ]
      next_stops <- bind_rows(
        tibble(to_stop_id = alight$stop_id, min_transfer_time = 0),
        example_transfers %>% filter(from_stop_id == alight$stop_id) %>% select(to_stop_id, min_transfer_time)
      )
      second <- example_schedule %>%
        inner_join(next_stops, by = c("stop_id" = "to_stop_id")) %>%
        filter(trip_id != trip, dep_s >= alight$arr_s + min_transfer_time) %>%
        inner_join(
          example_schedule %>%
            filter(stop_id == journey$to_stop_id, arr_s == journey$journey_arrival_time) %>%
            select(trip_id, end_seq = stop_sequence, end_arr = arr_s),
          by = "trip_id"
        ) %>%
        filter(stop_sequence < end_seq) %>%
        slice_min(dep_s, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
      if (nrow(second)) {
        return(tibble(
          trip_id = c(trip, second$trip_id),
          board_stop = c(journey$from_stop_id, second$stop_id),
          alight_stop = c(alight$stop_id, journey$to_stop_id),
          dep_s = c(journey$journey_departure_time, second$dep_s),
          arr_s = c(alight$arr_s, second$end_arr)
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  stop("Could not trace the example trip with at most one transfer.")
}

clock <- function(s) sub("^0", "", format(as.POSIXct(s, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"), "%I:%M %p"))
stop_title <- function(id) str_to_title(all_stops$stop_name[match(id, all_stops$stop_id)])

example_rides <- trace_rides(example_trip) %>%
  left_join(gtfs_full$trips %>% select(trip_id, route_id, shape_id), by = "trip_id") %>%
  left_join(gtfs_full$routes %>% select(route_id, route_short_name, route_type), by = "route_id") %>%
  mutate(
    mode = if_else(route_type == 1, "Rail", "Bus"),
    line_color = if_else(mode == "Rail", unname(rail_line_colors[route_short_name]), map_colors$bus),
    ride_name = if_else(mode == "Rail", paste(str_to_title(route_short_name), "line"), paste("bus", route_short_name)),
    transfer_s = c(0, purrr::map2_dbl(head(alight_stop, -1), board_stop[-1], function(from, to) {
      if (from == to) return(0)
      example_transfers$min_transfer_time[example_transfers$from_stop_id == from & example_transfers$to_stop_id == to][1]
    })),
    ready_s = c(example_trip$start_s + example_trip$walk_time_min * 60, head(arr_s, -1)) + transfer_s,
    hover = glue("{str_to_sentence(ride_name)}: {stop_title(board_stop)} {clock(dep_s)} → {stop_title(alight_stop)} {clock(arr_s)} ({round((dep_s - ready_s) / 60)} min wait, {round((arr_s - dep_s) / 60)} min ride)")
  )

# Cuts a GTFS shape between the boarding and alighting stops.
cut_shape <- function(shape, board_stop, alight_stop) {
  pts <- gtfs_full$shapes %>% filter(shape_id == shape) %>% arrange(shape_pt_sequence)
  pts_sf <- st_as_sf(pts, coords = c("shape_pt_lon", "shape_pt_lat"), crs = 4326)
  ends <- st_nearest_feature(st_transform(bind_rows(example_stop_point(board_stop), example_stop_point(alight_stop)), 4326), pts_sf)
  idx <- seq(min(ends), max(ends))
  st_sfc(st_linestring(as.matrix(pts[idx, c("shape_pt_lon", "shape_pt_lat")])), crs = 4326)
}
full_shape <- function(shape) {
  pts <- gtfs_full$shapes %>% filter(shape_id == shape) %>% arrange(shape_pt_sequence)
  st_sfc(st_linestring(as.matrix(pts[, c("shape_pt_lon", "shape_pt_lat")])), crs = 4326)
}

)

  },

) %>%

# Counts of destinations reachable within 15-90 min (15-min steps) and
# the 45-min bus-vs-rail difference are produced upstream by 06_summarize_metrics.R
reach_thresholds <- c(15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90)
threshold_cols <- function(scenario_name) paste0(scenario_name, "_n_", reach_thresholds)

tracts_leaflet <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(threshold_cols("rail_only"), threshold_cols("bus_rail"), diff_n_45),
      ~replace_na(., 0)
    )
  )

summary_reachability <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(across(c(threshold_cols("rail_only"), threshold_cols("bus_rail")), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("scenario", "threshold"), names_pattern = "^(.*)_n_(\\d+)$", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = recode(scenario, rail_only = "Rail only", bus_rail = "Multimodal"),
    threshold = paste0("<= ", threshold, " min")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = threshold, values_from = value)

add_reference_destination_markers <- function(map_obj, data) {
  for (type_name in names(dest_pin_uris)) {
    type_data <- data %>% filter(dest_type == type_name)
    if (!nrow(type_data)) next

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addMarkers(
        data = type_data,
        icon = makeIcon(
          iconUrl = dest_pin_uris[[type_name]],
          iconWidth = 21,
          iconHeight = 28,
          iconAnchorX = 10.5,
          iconAnchorY = 28,
          popupAnchorX = 0,
          popupAnchorY = -26
        ),
        label = ~dest_name,
        popup = ~glue("<strong>{dest_name}</strong><br/>{dest_type}"),
        group = "Destinations"
      )
  }

  map_obj
}

add_thematic_destination_markers <- function(map_obj, data) {
  for (type_name in names(dest_icon_names)) {
    type_data <- data %>% filter(dest_type == type_name)
    if (!nrow(type_data)) next

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = type_data,
        radius = 2,
        stroke = TRUE,
        weight = 0.7,
        color = "#ffffff",
        fillColor = map_colors$destination,
        fillOpacity = 0.9,
        label = ~dest_name,
        popup = ~glue("<strong>{dest_name}</strong><br/>{dest_type}"),
        group = "Destinations"
      )
  }

  map_obj
}

make_swatch_legend_html <- function(title, colors, labels) {
  HTML(
    paste0(
      "<div style='background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96); padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #d0d0d0;'>",
      "<div style='font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px;'>", title, "</div>",
      paste0(
        "<div style='margin-bottom: 4px;'><span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:",
        colors,
        ";margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>",
        labels,
        "</div>",
        collapse = ""
      ),
      "</div>"
    )
  )
}

make_component_legend_html <- function(title, items) {
  entry_html <- purrr::pmap_chr(items, function(type, color, label) {
    symbol <- if (type %in% c("line", "dash")) {
      paste0(
        "<span style='display:inline-block;width:18px;height:0;border-top:3px ",
        if (type == "dash") "dashed " else "solid ",
        color,
        ";margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>"
      )
    } else if (type == "icon") {
      paste0("<img src='", color, "' style='width:12px;height:16px;margin-right:10px;vertical-align:middle;'>")
    } else {
      paste0(
        "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:",
        color,
        ";border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>"
      )
    }

    paste0("<div style='margin-bottom: 4px;'>", symbol, label, "</div>")
  })

  HTML(
    paste0(
      "<div style='background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96); padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #d0d0d0;'>",
      "<div style='font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px;'>", title, "</div>",
      paste0(entry_html, collapse = ""),
      "</div>"
    )
  )
}

demographic_specs <- list(
  list(col = "hhinc", label = "Median household income", palette = c("#fff5eb", "#fdc38d", "#f16913", "#7f2704")),
  list(col = "pct_minority", label = "Percent minority", palette = c("#fff5eb", "#fdc38d", "#f16913", "#7f2704")),
  list(col = "pct_zero_vehicle", label = "Percent zero-vehicle households", palette = c("#fff5eb", "#fdc38d", "#f16913", "#7f2704"))
)

make_demographic_map <- function(sf_data, value_col, label, palette_colors) {
  value_fmt <- if (value_col == "hhinc") {
    function(x) dollar(x)
  } else {
    function(x) percent(x / 100, accuracy = 0.1)
  }

  viz_data <- sf_data %>%
    mutate(
      metric_value = .data[[value_col]],
      popup_html = glue(
        "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
        "<strong>{label}:</strong> {value_fmt(metric_value)}<br/>",
        "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
      )
    )

  pal <- colorNumeric(palette = palette_colors, domain = viz_data$metric_value, na.color = "#d9d9d9")

  leaflet(viz_data, height = city_map_height, options = map_options()) %>%
    add_carto_tiles() %>%
    fit_city() %>%
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(metric_value),
      fillOpacity = 0.84,
      color = "#faf7f2",
      weight = 0.5,
      popup = ~popup_html,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#111111", bringToFront = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      pal = pal,
      values = viz_data$metric_value,
      position = "bottomright",
      opacity = 0.9,
      na.label = "No data",
      labFormat = if (value_col == "hhinc") {
        labelFormat(prefix = "$", suffix = "k", transform = function(x) x / 1000)
      } else {
        labelFormat(suffix = "%")
      }
    )
}

make_leaflet_map <- function(sf_data, value_col, palette_colors, label, bins, legend_title, legend_labels) {
  viz_data <- sf_data %>%
    mutate(
      metric_value = .data[[value_col]],
      popup_html = glue(

        "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
      )
    )
  pal <- colorBin(palette = palette_colors, domain = viz_data$metric_value, bins = bins, na.color = "#d9d9d9", pretty = FALSE)

}

make_toggle_tt_map <- function(sf_data, rail_col, bus_col, title_prefix, palette_colors, bins, marker_dest) {
  map_obj <- leaflet(height = city_map_height, options = map_options()) %>%
    add_carto_tiles() %>%
    fit_city()

  shared_domain <- c(sf_data[[rail_col]], sf_data[[bus_col]])
  shared_pal <- colorBin(
    palette = palette_colors,
    domain = shared_domain,
    bins = bins,
    na.color = "#d9d9d9",
    pretty = FALSE
  )

  layer_specs <- list(
    list(col = rail_col, label = "Rail only"),
    list(col = bus_col, label = "Multimodal")
  )

  for (spec in layer_specs) {
    group_data <- sf_data %>%
      mutate(
        metric_value = .data[[spec$col]],
        popup_html = glue(
          "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
          "<strong>Median commute, {tolower(spec$label)}:</strong> {ifelse(is.na(metric_value), 'Not reachable', paste(round(metric_value, 1), 'min'))}<br/>",
          "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
          "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
          "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
        )
      )

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = group_data,
        fillColor = ~shared_pal(metric_value),
        fillOpacity = 0.84,
        color = "#faf7f2",
        weight = 0.5,
        popup = ~popup_html,
        group = spec$label,
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#111111", bringToFront = TRUE)
      )
  }

  map_obj %>%
    add_thematic_destination_markers(destinations_ll %>% filter(dest_name == marker_dest)) %>%
    addLegend(
      pal = shared_pal,
      values = shared_domain,
      title = title_prefix,
      position = "bottomright",
      opacity = 0.9,
      na.label = "Not reachable"
    ) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = purrr::map_chr(layer_specs, "label"),
      overlayGroups = "Destinations",
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE),
      position = "topleft"
    )
}

# Per-tract counts of destinations reachable within each minute, 0 to max_minutes.
reach_counts_by_minute <- function(sf_data, scenario_name, max_minutes) {
  tt <- travel_times_long %>% filter(scenario == scenario_name)
  purrr::map(sf_data$GEOID, function(geoid) {
    tract_tt <- tt$travel_time_min[tt$GEOID == geoid]
    vapply(0:max_minutes, function(m) sum(tract_tt <= m, na.rm = TRUE), integer(1))
  })
}

# Accessibility map driven by a shared travel-time slider: tracts are recolored
# by the number of destinations reachable within the selected minute.
make_threshold_slider_map <- function(sf_data, scenario_name, scenario_label, max_minutes, start_minutes, palette_colors, bins, slider_id) {
  n_dest <- nrow(destinations)
  counts <- reach_counts_by_minute(sf_data, scenario_name, max_minutes)
  pal <- colorBin(palette = palette_colors, domain = 0:n_dest, bins = bins, pretty = FALSE)

  viz_data <- sf_data %>%
    mutate(
      start_value = purrr::map_int(counts, start_minutes + 1),
      tract_info = glue(
        "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
      ),
      popup_html = glue("<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/><strong>Destinations within {start_minutes} min:</strong> {start_value} of {n_dest}<br/>{tract_info}")
    )

  leaflet(viz_data, width = "100%", height = 480, options = map_options()) %>%
    add_carto_tiles() %>%
    fit_city() %>%
    addPolygons(
      layerId = ~GEOID,
      fillColor = ~pal(start_value),
      fillOpacity = 0.84,
      color = "#faf7f2",
      weight = 0.5,
      popup = ~popup_html
    ) %>%
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      "function(el, x, data) {
        var map = this;
        var info = L.control({position: 'topleft'});
        info.onAdd = function() { return L.DomUtil.create('div', 'map-label'); };
        info.addTo(map);
        var label = info.getContainer();

        data.geoids.forEach(function(id) {
          var layer = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id);
          if (!layer) return;
          layer.on('mouseover', function() { this.setStyle({weight: 2, color: '#111111'}); this.bringToFront(); });
          layer.on('mouseout', function() { this.setStyle({weight: 0.5, color: '#faf7f2'}); });
        });

        function update(m) {
          var total = 0;
          data.geoids.forEach(function(id, i) {
            var n = data.counts[i][m];
            total += n;
            var layer = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id);
            if (!layer) return;
            layer.setStyle({fillColor: data.colors[n]});
            layer.setPopupContent('<strong>Tract:</strong> ' + data.names[i] + '<br/><strong>Destinations within ' + m +
              ' min:</strong> ' + n + ' of ' + data.n_dest + '<br/>' + data.info[i]);
          });
          label.innerHTML = '<strong>' + data.label + '</strong><br/>Average: ' + (total / data.geoids.length).toFixed(2) + ' of ' + data.n_dest;
        }
        window.reachMaps = window.reachMaps || [];
        window.reachMaps.push(update);

        // Keeps both maps on the same view while panning and zooming.
        window.reachMapObjs = window.reachMapObjs || [];
        window.reachMapObjs.push(map);
        map.on('move', function() {
          if (window.reachSyncing) return;
          window.reachSyncing = true;
          window.reachMapObjs.forEach(function(other) {
            if (other !== map) other.setView(map.getCenter(), map.getZoom(), {animate: false});
          });
          window.reachSyncing = false;
        });
        var input = document.getElementById(data.slider);
        update(input ? +input.value : data.start);
      }",
      data = list(
        geoids = viz_data$GEOID,
        names = viz_data$NAME,
        info = as.character(viz_data$tract_info),
        counts = counts,
        colors = unname(pal(0:n_dest)),
        n_dest = n_dest,
        label = scenario_label,
        slider = slider_id,
        start = start_minutes
      )
    )
}

# Rail-only and multimodal slider maps side by side, with one shared slider and legend.
make_paired_slider_maps <- function(sf_data, max_minutes, start_minutes, palette_colors, bins, legend_labels) {
  slider_id <- "reach-slider"
  pal <- colorBin(palette = palette_colors, domain = 0:nrow(destinations), bins = bins, pretty = FALSE)
  legend_colors <- unname(pal((head(bins, -1) + tail(bins, -1)) / 2))

  tags$div(
    class = "paired-frame",
    tags$div(
      class = "paired-maps",
      tags$div(make_threshold_slider_map(sf_data, "rail_only", "Rail only", max_minutes, start_minutes, palette_colors, bins, slider_id)),
      tags$div(make_threshold_slider_map(sf_data, "bus_rail", "Multimodal", max_minutes, start_minutes, palette_colors, bins, slider_id))
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "time-slider",
      tags$div(tags$strong("Within ", tags$span(id = paste0(slider_id, "-value"), start_minutes), " min")),
      tags$input(
        type = "range", id = slider_id, min = 0, max = max_minutes, step = 1, value = start_minutes,
        oninput = glue("var v = +this.value; document.getElementById('{slider_id}-value').textContent = v; (window.reachMaps || []).forEach(function(f) {{ f(v); }});")
      ),
      tags$div(class = "ts-scale", tags$span("0"), tags$span(max_minutes))
    ),
    tags$div(class = "reach-legend", make_swatch_legend_html("Destinations", legend_colors, legend_labels))
  )
}

# Box plot of one equity indicator for all tracts and the transit-access subsets,
# with each subset's p-value against the other tracts above its box.
make_subset_box <- function(data, value_col, y_title, p_values, tick_prefix = "", tick_suffix = "") {
  # Percent axes share a 0-100% scale so the panels line up.
  y_max <- if (tick_suffix == "%") 100 else max(data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  plot_ly(
    data = data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]])),
    x = ~group,
    y = ~.data[[value_col]],
    color = ~group,
    colors = subset_colors,
    type = "box",
    boxpoints = "all",
    jitter = 0.3,
    pointpos = 0,
    marker = list(opacity = 0.6, size = 5),
    hovertext = ~glue("Tract: {NAME}<br>{y_title}: {tick_prefix}{format(round(.data[[value_col]]), big.mark = ',')}{tick_suffix}"),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = y_title, tickprefix = tick_prefix, ticksuffix = tick_suffix, range = c(0, y_max * 1.15)),
      annotations = purrr::map2(names(p_values), unname(p_values), ~ list(
        x = .x, y = y_max * 1.04, xref = "x", yref = "y",
        text = format_p(.y), showarrow = FALSE, yanchor = "bottom", font = list(size = 10)
      ))
    )
}

format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", ifelse(p < 0.01, sprintf("p = %.3f", p), sprintf("p = %.2f", p)))

plotly_theme <- list(

  yaxis = list(gridcolor = "#d9d2c3", zerolinecolor = "#d9d2c3")
)
```

```{r overview-stats}
rail_wait <- mean(tract_summary$wait_cost[tract_summary$scenario == "rail_only"], na.rm = TRUE)
tracts_tbl <- tracts_final %>% st_drop_geometry()
access_tracts <- tracts_tbl %>% filter(bus_rail_n_reachable > 0)
pct_over_45 <- round(100 * mean(access_tracts$bus_rail_median_tt > 45))
pct_over_60 <- round(100 * mean(access_tracts$bus_rail_median_tt > 60))
no_access_tracts <- tracts_tbl %>% filter(bus_rail_n_reachable == 0)
n_no_access_high_income <- sum(no_access_tracts$hhinc > median(tracts_tbl$hhinc, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
most_car_free <- tracts_tbl %>% filter(ntile(pct_zero_vehicle, 4) == 4)
n_most_car_free_no_access <- sum(most_car_free$bus_rail_n_reachable == 0)
rail_dest_ids <- travel_times_long %>% filter(scenario == "rail_only", reachable) %>% distinct(dest_id) %>% pull()
bus_dest_names <- destinations$dest_name[!destinations$dest_id %in% rail_dest_ids]

dest_type_labels <- c(job_center = "Job centers", education = "Universities", hospital = "Hospitals", airport = "Airport")
destination_list_html <- destinations %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(dest_type) %>%
  summarise(names = paste(dest_name, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(dest_type = factor(dest_type, levels = names(dest_type_labels))) %>%
  arrange(dest_type) %>%
  glue_data("<li>{dest_type_labels[as.character(dest_type)]}: {names}</li>") %>%
  paste(collapse = "")
```

# Overview

::: {.callout}
**Goal:** Measure how well MARTA's multimodal transit network connects Atlanta census tracts to `r n_destinations` key destinations (job centers, universities, hospitals, and the airport), and whether higher-need neighborhoods are adequately served.

**Approach:** Compare scheduled weekday morning peak (7–8 AM) travel times from each of `r n_tracts` tracts under two scenarios, rail only and multimodal (bus + rail). Relate the results to median household income, percent minority, and percent zero-vehicle households.
:::

<div class="stat-tiles">
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r fmt2(rail_n45)` → `r fmt2(bus_n45)` of `r n_destinations`</div><div class="stat-label">Average destinations reachable within 45 min, rail only → multimodal</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r n_rail_tracts` → `r n_bus_tracts` of `r n_tracts`</div><div class="stat-label">Tracts with transit access, rail only → multimodal</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r round(bus_typical_tt)` min</div><div class="stat-label">Typical multimodal trip, including the wait</div></div>
</div>

# Methods

1. **Clip to study area:** OSM streets and paths are clipped to the study tracts plus a 3 km buffer around the city edge.
2. **Walk network:** walkable streets and paths (no motorways), joined at intersections into one connected `sfnetworks` network, weighted by segment length so shortest paths are in meters.
3. **Origins:** one population-weighted centroid per tract, where residents live.
4. **Walk links:** shortest network walk of up to 800 m (0.5 mi, about 10 min) from each centroid to nearby stops, and from stops to each destination. Transfer walks between stops are up to 400 m and take at least 2 min.
5. **Transit routing:** weekday rail-only and multimodal (bus + rail) schedules, for riders leaving home every minute from 7 to 8 AM and arriving by 10 AM, with up to 3 transfers and a 2-hour maximum trip.
6. **Metrics:** each tract's median door-to-door time (walks, waits, and rides) to each destination, summarized as destinations reachable within each commute time, min, median, mean, and max commute, and wait cost.

<details class="spaced">
<summary>Code excerpt: walking network (<code>scripts/03_prepare_walking_network.R</code>)</summary>

```r
walk_lines <- st_read(osm_lines_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  # Walkable ways only (no motorways).
  filter(highway %in% c(
    "footway", "path", "pedestrian", "living_street", "residential",
    "service", "unclassified", "tertiary", "secondary", "primary",
    "steps", "corridor", "cycleway", "track"
  )) %>%
  st_transform(study_crs) %>%
  # Clip to the study area plus a 3 km buffer.
  st_intersection(study_area) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING", warn = FALSE)

walk_net <- walk_lines %>%
  sfnetworks::as_sfnetwork(directed = FALSE) %>%
  # Split streets where they cross so intersections connect.
  tidygraph::convert(sfnetworks::to_spatial_subdivision, .clean = TRUE) %>%
  # Keep the largest connected network.
  activate(nodes) %>%
  filter(tidygraph::group_components() == 1) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(weight = as.numeric(st_length(geometry)))
```

</details>

Transit routing uses `tidytransit::raptor()`, an R implementation of the established RAPTOR algorithm that routes directly on GTFS timetables and transfers.

<details>
<summary>Code excerpt: RAPTOR routing (<code>scripts/05_compute_accessibility.R</code>)</summary>

```r
# Every scheduled journey from the tract's stops, 7:00-8:10 AM.
raptor_res <- tidytransit::raptor(
  stop_times = stop_times_obj,
  transfers = attr(stop_times_obj, "transfers"),
  stop_ids = candidate_stops$stop_id,
  time_range = raptor_time_range,
  max_transfers = max_transfers,
  keep = "all"
)

# For each home departure minute, take the earliest arrival among
# trips the rider can still catch after walking to the stop.
door_to_door_by_start <- function(leave_by, arrive) {
  ord <- order(leave_by)
  leave_by <- leave_by[ord]
  best_arrival <- rev(cummin(rev(arrive[ord])))
  next_trip <- findInterval(start_times, leave_by, left.open = TRUE) + 1
  tt <- rep(Inf, length(start_times))
  catchable <- next_trip <= length(leave_by)
  tt[catchable] <- (best_arrival[next_trip[catchable]] - start_times[catchable]) / 60
  tt
}
# Travel time = median over the 61 departure minutes (over 2 h = unreachable).
```

</details>

[Pipeline scripts](https://github.com/klosada/MARTA_Accessibility_Equity/tree/main/scripts) · [Code sample](https://github.com/klosada/MARTA_Accessibility_Equity/blob/main/scripts/code_sample.R)

## Routing Example

```{r walking-service-area-map}
# Network service area: walking paths reachable within 800 m of the centroid,
# with edges that cross the limit cut at the exact 800 m point.
walk_node_cost <- as.numeric(walk_example_costs[1, ])
service_edges <- walk_edges %>%
  mutate(
    len = as.numeric(st_length(geometry)),
    starts_at_from = as.numeric(st_distance(lwgeom::st_startpoint(geometry), st_geometry(walk_nodes)[from], by_element = TRUE)) < 0.01,
    from_end_cost = if_else(starts_at_from, walk_node_cost[from], walk_node_cost[to]),
    to_end_cost = if_else(starts_at_from, walk_node_cost[to], walk_node_cost[from]),
    reach_start = pmax(0, pmin(len, max_walk_meters - from_end_cost)),
    reach_end = pmax(0, pmin(len, max_walk_meters - to_end_cost))
  ) %>%
  filter(reach_start > 0 | reach_end > 0)

service_paths <- purrr::pmap(service_edges %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(geom = st_geometry(service_edges)), function(len, reach_start, reach_end, geom, ...) {
  if (reach_start + reach_end >= len) return(list(geom))
  pieces <- list()
  if (reach_start > 0) pieces <- c(pieces, list(lwgeom::st_linesubstring(st_sfc(geom, crs = st_crs(walk_edges)), 0, reach_start / len)[[1]]))
  if (reach_end > 0) pieces <- c(pieces, list(lwgeom::st_linesubstring(st_sfc(geom, crs = st_crs(walk_edges)), 1 - reach_end / len, 1)[[1]]))
  pieces
}) %>%
  unlist(recursive = FALSE) %>%
  st_sfc(crs = st_crs(walk_edges)) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Stops within an 800 m network walk (as used in routing) vs. inside the straight-line radius only.
walk_reachable_stop_ids <- origin_stop_lookup %>%
  filter(GEOID == walk_example_geoid, scenario == "bus_rail") %>%
  pull(stop_id)
service_stops_vis <- walk_example_stops %>%
  mutate(
    stop_type = case_when(
      !stop_id %in% walk_reachable_stop_ids ~ "Beyond an 800 m walk",
      is_rail ~ "Rail station",
      TRUE ~ "Bus stop"
    )
  ) %>%
  collapse_stop_points(c("stop_name", "stop_type"))

# Map extent: the walk area and tract, with space on the right for the legend.
service_bounds <- st_bbox(c(st_geometry(walk_threshold_ring), st_geometry(tracts_leaflet %>% filter(GEOID == walk_example_geoid))))

service_area_legend_html <- make_component_legend_html(
  "Legend",
  tibble::tribble(
    ~type, ~color, ~label,
    "line", map_colors$tract, "Census tract boundary",
    "dash", "#8c8c8c", "800 m straight-line radius",
    "line", map_colors$walk, "Walking paths within 800 m",
    "point", map_colors$centroid, "Population-weighted centroid",
    "point", map_colors$rail_stop, "Rail station within an 800 m walk",
    "point", map_colors$bus, "Bus stop within an 800 m walk",
    "point", map_colors$context, "Stop beyond an 800 m walk"
  )
)

browsable(tagList(
  tags$h4("Walking paths within 800 m of one tract's population-weighted centroid (network service area)"),
  leaflet(options = map_options()) %>%
    add_carto_tiles() %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = tracts_leaflet %>% filter(GEOID == walk_example_geoid),
      fillColor = map_colors$tract_fill,

      opacity = 1,
      popup = ~glue("<strong>Example tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/><strong>GEOID:</strong> {GEOID}")
    ) %>%

))
```

# Results

## Accessibility

#### Average destinations reachable by commute time

Average number of the `r n_destinations` destinations a tract can reach within each commute time, across all `r n_tracts` tracts. Rail-only averages stay low because only `r n_rail_tracts` tracts have a station within an 800 m walk.

```{r reachability-summary}
summary_reachability %>%
  mutate(across(-scenario, ~ sprintf("%.2f", .x))) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Scenario", names(summary_reachability)[-1]),
    align = c("l", rep("r", length(reach_thresholds)))
  )
```

#### Commute times to reachable destinations

For each tract with access, the shortest, median, mean, and longest of its median door-to-door commutes to the destinations it can reach, averaged across tracts. Wait cost is the extra time a rider loses by leaving at any minute from 7 to 8 AM instead of at the best-timed departure.

```{r travel-time-summary}
accessibility_summary %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% tracts_final$GEOID) %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    tracts_with_access = sum(n_reachable > 0),
    n_reachable = mean(n_reachable[n_reachable > 0]),
    across(c(min_tt, median_tt, mean_tt, max_tt, wait_cost), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = recode(scenario, rail_only = "Rail only", bus_rail = "Multimodal"),
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("Rail only", "Multimodal")),
    n_reachable = sprintf("%.1f of %d", n_reachable, n_destinations),
    across(c(min_tt, median_tt, mean_tt, max_tt, wait_cost), ~ sprintf("%.1f", .x))
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Scenario", "Tracts with access", "Reachable destinations", "Min commute (min)", "Median commute (min)", "Mean commute (min)", "Max commute (min)", "Wait cost (min)"),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
  )
```

## Equity

Are higher-need tracts adequately served by MARTA?

```{r map-demographics}
income_map <- make_demographic_map(tracts_leaflet, "hhinc", "Median household income", demographic_specs[[1]]$palette)
minority_map <- make_demographic_map(tracts_leaflet, "pct_minority", "Percent minority", demographic_specs[[2]]$palette)
zero_vehicle_map <- make_demographic_map(tracts_leaflet, "pct_zero_vehicle", "Percent zero-vehicle households", demographic_specs[[3]]$palette)

browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h4("Median household income by tract (ACS 2019–2023)"),
    income_map,
    tags$h4("Share of residents who are people of color"),
    minority_map,
    tags$h4("Share of households without a vehicle"),
    zero_vehicle_map
  )
)
```

```{r equity-subsets-data}
subset_colors <- c("#d9c9b6", "#7f2704", "#f16913")
equity_base <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    no_access = bus_rail_n_reachable == 0,
    rail_access = rail_only_n_reachable > 0
  )
subset_labels <- c(
  glue("All tracts ({nrow(equity_base)})"),
  glue("No transit access ({sum(equity_base$no_access)})"),
  glue("Rail access ({sum(equity_base$rail_access)})")
)
equity_subsets <- bind_rows(
  equity_base %>% mutate(group = subset_labels[1]),
  equity_base %>% filter(no_access) %>% mutate(group = subset_labels[2]),
  equity_base %>% filter(rail_access) %>% mutate(group = subset_labels[3])
) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = subset_labels))

# Rank-sum test of each subset against the other tracts, for one indicator.
subset_p <- function(col, subset) suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(equity_base[[col]][equity_base[[subset]]], equity_base[[col]][!equity_base[[subset]]])$p.value)
group_p <- function(col) setNames(c(subset_p(col, "no_access"), subset_p(col, "rail_access")), subset_labels[2:3])
```

#### Income, minority share, and car-free households in tracts with no transit access and tracts with rail access

```{r equity-subsets, fig.height = 4.5}
subplot(
  make_subset_box(equity_subsets, "hhinc", "Median household income", group_p("hhinc"), tick_prefix = "$"),
  make_subset_box(equity_subsets, "pct_minority", "Percent minority", group_p("pct_minority"), tick_suffix = "%"),
  make_subset_box(equity_subsets, "pct_zero_vehicle", "Percent zero-vehicle households", group_p("pct_zero_vehicle"), tick_suffix = "%"),
  nrows = 1,
  margin = 0.06,
  titleY = TRUE
) %>%
  layout(plotly_theme)
```

p-values compare each group with all other tracts (Wilcoxon test). Values below 0.05 are significant.

Tracts with no transit access tend to be higher-income, with fewer car-free households than the city overall. Tracts with rail access look like the city as a whole.

## Key Findings

<div class="stat-tiles">
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r round(bus_wait)` min</div><div class="stat-key">average wait cost on multimodal trips</div><div class="stat-desc">Rail averages `r round(rail_wait, 1)` min, since trains run more often.</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r length(bus_dest_names)` of `r n_destinations`</div><div class="stat-key">destinations need a bus</div><div class="stat-desc">`r knitr::combine_words(bus_dest_names)`.</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r pct_over_45`% of tracts</div><div class="stat-key">have a median multimodal commute over 45 min</div><div class="stat-desc">`r pct_over_60`% have one over an hour.</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r n_no_stop` tracts</div><div class="stat-key">have no transit access</div><div class="stat-desc">No stop is within an 800 m walk of the tract's population-weighted centroid.</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r n_no_access_high_income` of `r n_no_stop`</div><div class="stat-key">tracts with no access are above the city's median income</div><div class="stat-desc">MARTA coverage favors lower-income and car-free tracts. `r if (n_most_car_free_no_access == 0) "None" else n_most_car_free_no_access` of the `r nrow(most_car_free)` most car-free tracts lack access.</div></div>
</div>

Buses extend access from `r n_rail_tracts` to `r n_bus_tracts` tracts, but the typical multimodal trip takes `r round(bus_typical_tt)` min and about `r round(bus_wait)` of it is spent waiting. MARTA's stop coverage favors lower-income and car-free tracts, and the `r n_no_stop` tracts without a walkable stop are mostly higher-income. For most residents, the gap is service frequency and speed rather than coverage.

# Limitations

- **Tract centroid:** Each tract is one population-weighted point, so within-tract variation is missed, and the `r n_no_stop` tracts whose point is more than an 800 m walk from a stop show no access.
- **Time period:** Riders leave home between 7 and 8 AM on a weekday. Other times and weekends are not covered.
- **Schedule service data:** Travel times use scheduled GTFS service, not real-world delays, reliability, or crowding.
- **Selective destination layer:** Only `r n_destinations` destinations, not broader urban activity patterns.
- **Walking approximation:** OpenStreetMap may overstate or understate walk access in places. Transfers within stations are approximated as walks of at least 2 min.
